description: This file defines the Fill class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages fill styles for spreadsheet cells, including fill types, colors, rotation, and related style application methods.

classes.name: Fill
classes.description: Represents the fill style for a cell, including fill type, colors, rotation, and related style management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes fill style properties and optionally sets up supervisor behavior.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Returns the shared fill component, mainly used in supervisor mode.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and returns a style array from given subcomponents.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an input array, updating fill type, rotation, and colors.

methods.name: getFillType
methods.description: Retrieves the fill type (e.g., none, solid, gradient) for the style.

methods.name: setFillType
methods.description: Sets the fill type for the style.

methods.name: getRotation
methods.description: Gets the rotation angle for gradient fills.

methods.name: setRotation
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle for gradient fills.

methods.name: setStartColor
methods.description: Sets the start color for the fill.

methods.name: setEndColor
methods.description: Sets the end color for the fill.

methods.name: getColorsChanged
methods.description: Indicates if the fill's colors have been changed.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash representing the current fill style.
